name: Onboarding kickoff — Corvane HVAC Services

turns.speaker: theo-park
turns.text: Welcome to onboarding, Dana. I have Lena's handoff; let's plan the rollout.

turns.speaker: dana-whitlock
turns.text: We want to pilot in three branches first: Denver, Boulder and Aurora. The other eleven branches follow once the pilot is stable.

turns.speaker: theo-park
turns.text: Who owns the technical setup on your side?

turns.speaker: dana-whitlock
turns.text: Marcus Bell, our IT admin. He will handle Okta and the technician data import.

turns.speaker: dana-whitlock
turns.text: October 14 works. We have 30 dispatchers, and most of them have never scheduled jobs from a phone.

turns.speaker: theo-park
turns.text: Booked: dispatcher training on October 14 with Ines Calder.

handoff: Kickoff note (Theo Park, 2026-09-08): The pilot branches are Denver, Boulder and Aurora; the other 11 branches follow after the pilot.
Kickoff note (Theo Park, 2026-09-08): Marcus Bell, Corvane's IT admin, owns the Okta setup and the technician import; dispatcher training is on October 14.
